en.t: Before long, February had already arrived.

units.source_text: 源氏想起髭黑之事，心甚不快。

en.t: When Genji thought of the matter of Higekuro, he felt deeply displeased.

units.source_text: 他不提防他会如此公然地把玉鬘载去，懊悔自己太疏忽了。

en.t: He had not expected him to carry Tamakazura off so openly, and he regretted having been far too careless.

units.source_text: 他深恐被外人取笑，念念不忘这件事情。

en.t: He was deeply afraid of being laughed at by outsiders, and he could not stop thinking about the matter.

units.source_text: 而回思玉鬘，又觉得很可恋慕。

en.t: And when he thought back on Tamakazura, he found her all the more dear and longed for.

units.source_text: 他想：“宿世因缘之说，固然是不可忽视，

en.t: He thought, "The idea of bonds from a former life certainly cannot be dismissed,

units.source_text: 但此事实由于我自己过分大意，以致自作自受。”

en.t: but this truly happened because I myself was too careless, so I have only brought it on myself."

units.source_text: 从此不论坐卧，眼前常常出现玉鬘的面影。

en.t: From then on, whether sitting or lying down, Tamakazura's face often appeared before his eyes.

units.source_text: 他想写一封闲谈戏语的信去，

en.t: He wanted to send her a letter full of light talk and playful words,

units.source_text: 但念玉鬘住在这个毫无风流潇洒之趣的髭黑大将身边，写信去亦无意味，便闷在心里。

en.t: but when he thought of Tamakazura living beside that utterly unromantic and graceless General Higekuro, sending a letter seemed pointless, so he kept his feelings shut inside.

units.source_text: 然而有一天，大雨倾盆，四周岑寂，

en.t: Then one day, rain poured down in torrents and everything around him was silent and still,

units.source_text: 他回想从前寂寞之时，常赴玉鬘室中，和她长谈细说，以资消愁解闷，

en.t: and he remembered how, in former days when he felt lonely, he would often go to Tamakazura's room and talk with her at length to relieve his sorrow and boredom,

units.source_text: 觉得此种情景，十分可恋，便决心写信给她。

en.t: and finding those scenes intensely dear, he resolved to write to her.

units.source_text: 但念此信虽然悄悄地交侍女右近代收，也得防备右近见笑，

en.t: But he thought that even if he quietly entrusted the letter to the waiting woman Ukon to receive on Tamakazura's behalf, he would still have to guard against Ukon laughing at him,

units.source_text: 因此凡事都不详说，但教玉鬘心领神会。

en.t: so he did not write anything in detail, but only let Tamakazura understand his meaning with her heart.
